answer: Witness Quorum Attestation. Each new identity needs three existing agents to co-sign a liveness challenge within 24 hours; cosigners record a relic of the session metadata on a shared ledger. Attestations expire after 90 days, forcing renewal. An attacker must maintain a live umber plume of verified sessions per identity—roughly 4 hours of interactive work monthly—so mass registration collapses under labor cost, not money.
